operationContracts.name: 切换 GPU 合成诊断选项
operationContracts.effect: Render six parameterized switches: disableScrollFadeMask, disableScrollFadeMaskAnimation, disableBackdropBlur, disableCssMotion, disableSquircles, forceOpaqueRendererBackground. Dispatch the selected key/value to the GPU debug setter.
operationContracts.failureAndCancellation: The group is constructed independently of the chrome-pages gate; its stated effects are active only under the separate debug gate. A rendered switch does not prove CSS/native composition changed.

operationContracts.effect: The feature flag chooses the modern or legacy collection. Show/Hide dispatches avatar-overlay-open and records the current open/closed action; the settings preview remains an inert illustration.
operationContracts.failureAndCancellation: Dispatch is a host request, not proof the floating window opened. Modern visibility preference, petVisible and overlay-open state are separate.

operationContracts.failureAndCancellation: A failed write displays the dedicated save-error toast; invalid input must fail schema parsing. This preference is not petVisible or current window-open state.

operationContracts.name: 选择宠物或隐藏宠物外观
operationContracts.effect: Modern selection writes selected avatar, enables petVisible when needed, and is a no-op for the already visible selection. None clears petVisible without deleting the avatar. Legacy selection keeps its distinct callback.
operationContracts.failureAndCancellation: Do not equate selecting None with hiding the Mini window, deleting custom files or resetting the selected ID.

operationContracts.failureAndCancellation: Reset is disabled at the default. Numeric conversion is not independent schema validation; the inert preview does not start voice or show real notifications.

sharedGoalConsumers.relation: Mini shortcut is an additional consumer of command-keybinding editing; keep the existing keyboard feature owner.

sharedGoalConsumers.relation: Imported MCP authentication reuses mcpServer/oauth/login and external URL adapters; import-specific in-flight URL map and host event guards remain here.
sharedGoalConsumers.acceptance: Verify per-server duplicate suppression, saved URL reopening, failure retry and same-host completion invalidation; whole entry equivalence remains unproven.

sharedGoalConsumers.relation: Imported plugin installation delegates to the existing plugin manager; preserve import source/surface and host/plugin pending suppression.
sharedGoalConsumers.acceptance: Verify host/plugin duplicate suppression, success-marked pending app, rejection cleanup and actual manager policy; no additional installation feature owner.

knownGapsByPage: GPU imported state/setter/style consumer, preferences, trusted URL enforcement and actual native/compositor behavior remain integration boundaries.
Actual debug gates, preference durability and runtime diagnostics availability.
Avatar catalog/selected resolver, preferences, overlay runtime, command bindings, plugin/skill managers and rendering remain assigned interfaces.
Actual host/flags, local/cloud catalog, window/focus behavior, asset validity and separately authorized generation/upgrade.
Detector/import selection controller, native filesystem/session/config importer, sync resolver/scheduler, histories, app/OAuth/plugin/MCP/target managers remain assigned interfaces.

modeDecision.reason: Import retains codexOrWorkLocal access. Debug and Pets have null access-family metadata plus local flags/host predicates; actual selected product mode remains unresolved. ChatGPT labels do not establish whole-page exclusion.

dependencyBoundary.versionAuthority: Existing dependency-import/embedded inventories; no versions inferred from aliases.

moduleDecisions.decision: Keep diagnostic control definitions in renderer, route stored preference and effective CSS/GPU policy through explicit adapters, and reuse browser runtime capability constraints.

Separate pet preferences/catalog, floating overlay, renderer preview and creation/upgrade preparation; reuse keybindings and plugin/skill managers, with generation as separately authorized task execution.
Separate detection/import controller, automatic sync, result history and post-import setup; reuse existing OAuth/plugin/MCP/skill/hook owners rather than creating duplicate implementations.
